title: VeRA Mirror scaling code bank
hypothesis: At a common frozen random low-rank basis, Givens Mirror task codes improve regression quality or multiplicity over VeRA scaling vectors at comparable serialized bytes.
physical_object: One frozen shared random low-rank A/B basis (rank 4)
mirror_coordinate: Task-specific Givens transforms on rank channels

task.metric: mean and worst task held-out MSE

controls: native VeRA task left/right scale vectors
same shared basis with task Givens Mirror codes

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus canonical JSON metadata
paid_objects: shared frozen random A/B basis or exact generator metadata
all task scale or Mirror codes

success_gate: Mirror mean MSE <=1.10x independent, bytes <=60% independent, and >=10% lower MSE than VeRA at byte-near storage (within 15%) or lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage gate or VeRA matches at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: all methods use same basis/teacher per world
